classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory determination accepting the agreement and terminates the Section 301 investigation; the legal consequence occurs in this segment rather than through a later agency decision.
classifications.evidence: I have determined to accept the agreement described below as an appropriate and feasible action to resolve this investigation and therefore to terminate the investigation.

classifications.rationale: The President directs the USTR to give notice and undertake implementation and monitoring, without dictating a separate later legal outcome affecting rights or obligations.
classifications.evidence: I direct the United States Trade Representative (USTR) to notify the Government of Korea of my approval of the agreement and to take any actions necessary to implement and monitor it.

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the substantive statutory Section 301 determination concerning Korea's trade restrictions; the remaining text explains the agreement and its anticipated foreign implementation.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that these restrictions were unjustifiable, unreasonable, or discriminatory and a burden or restriction on U.S commerce.
